proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 61 prints /ən.nə/ with the generic grain gloss. Turner395 section 1 gives Pk aṇṇa food/grain and NiDoc aṁna corn, with later L/P ann grain. The source geminate is meaningful, and section 2 *anda- meat is excluded.

proposals.evidence: Dhakal pp. 54 and 67 print /dzʰor/ liquid/soup. Turner5416 gives Maithili jhor soup, Nepali/Bengali jhol juice/soup and Oriya jhoḷa. The source voiced aspirated affricate and final r fit the eastern comparison, which is more specific than a generic liquid match.
